title: 5 O'Clock Shadow Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Located just outside Rosemary Beach in Inlet, this new build is calling 5 o'clock shadow and is steps to the beach!
description_expanded: ✨JUST LISTED, BRAND NEW home and NEW to the rental market for summer 2026✨ Located in Inlet Beach, just one street outside Rosemary Beach, this 5 bedroom/6 bath new build has everything you could want out of a beach rental. Steps to the beach! Gulf Views! 2 Bikes! Beautifully appointed! Brand New Community pool HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • IDEAL location - STEPS to the first beach access In Inlet Beach - 1 minute walk! One street east of Rosemary Beach! • 2 Beach cruiser bikes! • 4 KING suites, all with private en-suite baths and TVs • Kid/Teen suite on third floor with additional TV room • Community Street pool • Private parking spaces in driveway • Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals • Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. ✨OPTIONAL ADD-ONS✨ → Optional Cancellation Protection → Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($200 fee applies at booking). SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: Floor 1 • KING Suite 1, TV, private en-suite bath (shower only) • KING Suite 2. TV, private en-suite bath (shower only) • KING Suite 3. TV, private en-suite bath (shower only) Floor 2 • PRIMARY KING suite 4, TV, private en-suite bath, double sinks, large shower with separate tub Living Room with ample seating with direct access to second floor balcony, large TV, beautiful gourmet kitchen, large dining table, full bath (shower only) Floor 3 • BUNK ROOM (4 fulls), private en-suite bath (shower only) Living Room 2, TV, direct access to 3rd floor balcony Must be 25 years old to rent No pets allowed FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
